verdict.rationale: Jan's docs say it can "Connect Jan with Claude Code, OpenClaw, MCP servers, and more", and it ships an OpenAI-compatible local server at localhost:1337 that third-party tools can point at. Nothing in the evidence shows a single command that launches those coding-agent CLIs already configured to use local models, so the integration appears to need manual setup. Missing for 10: a documented single-command launcher for third-party coding agent CLIs, automatic pre-configuration of local model endpoints, a list of supported agents beyond a one-line mention, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
